content:
Hi all,

I have opened a draft mathlib4 PR #40337 (feat(Probability): add condExpKernel prefix support). The PR adds two probability-kernel lemmas plus their supporting infrastructure, both axiom-clean against [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], with a MathlibTest elaboration check, and CI is currently green.

My workflow on this PR: I study the relevant probability theory myself (the prefix conditional-expectation kernel decomposition follows the same condExpKernel_* family already in Mathlib/Probability/Kernel/Condexp.lean, and I read the surrounding mathlib code by hand to align with the existing API). I use Whispr for voice control and Claude Code for repository search, mathlib API discovery, and summarization of existing topic infrastructure (in this case, the condExpKernel family in the probability folder). I am not using openclaw, clawdbot, or autopilot-style tools.

Self-assessment on the visidata scale: between level 5 and level 6 similar as my self-assessment on PR #40085. I could be mistaken about my final understanding at level 6.

Why mathlib4 specifically: the conditional-expectation kernel prefix decomposition fits the existing condExpKernel_* family in Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.Condexp and is used in downstream probability work (concentration inequalities, time-uniform inference, conditional independence proofs) needs in the canonical library.

I am happy to take any technical feedback on the proof or the API on the PR thread, and to answer policy questions here. Thank you for your time.

Rob
